title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 16: Honor

scenes.say: A veterans group invites him to speak on Memorial Day.
scenes.visual: rows of small American flags on a green lawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He almost says no. Then he thinks about who can't be there.
scenes.visual: a man standing alone by a war memorial wall at dawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He wears the medals he never talks about.
scenes.visual: military medals pinned to a dark suit, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a man's finger tracing an engraved name on a memorial, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Then the names of every brother he lost.
scenes.visual: a memorial wall with engraved names, flowers at the base, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Honor isn't the uniform. It's what you do after you take it off.
scenes.visual: a folded dress uniform on a chair, soft light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: An old Vietnam vet salutes him from the front row.
scenes.visual: an elderly veteran in a cap saluting, seen from the side in sunlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali salutes back, tears he doesn't wipe.
scenes.visual: a crisp salute silhouetted against a bright sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: For the hood, for the Army, for the ones who didn't make it.
scenes.visual: an American flag waving slowly over a cemetery, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He carries them by living loud.
scenes.visual: a man walking through rows of headstones at golden hour, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Seventeen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: taps bugle on a stand at sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 16 of 25: Honor. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
